# Tidewater — the Verbs (what the system does)

Everything the enterprise does, as functions: each takes information in and
hands one result on (→). A function is made of the functions indented beneath it, 2 levels deep,
with 2 to 9 steps at each level. The top level: sample, send, ingest, check, store, publish.

```
Observe Coast  → Bulletin
├── Sample Sensors  → Observation Record
├── Transmit Observations
├── Ingest Observations  → Observation Record
├── Check Quality  → Observation Record
├── Archive Observations
└── Publish Bulletin  → Bulletin
```
